about: Sheldon Aronson works from South Hood Avenue in Portland and is the firm itself: one name on the site, one office, and a free consultation.

Its Google listing averages a flat five stars across 84 reviews. It states no fee model in terms we could record, publishes only attorney bios of the trust pages pillar D looks for, and its site is the slowest in this market on Core Web Vitals.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Oregon does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Oregon on the conduct of Oregon State Bar members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 457 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Oregon on the conduct of Oregon State Bar members, 1951 to 2017. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 1 physical location verified on Google Business Profile. We read the Active Businesses register (data.oregon.gov tckn-sxa6), published as open data by the Oregon Secretary of State and could not identify this firm in it: no entity whose name contains the firm's name. A miss there is not evidence that the firm is unregistered, so this gate is unresolved rather than failed.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 1 named attorney published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 84 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2006-05-30, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

score.verdict: All 5 eligibility gates passed. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
